answer: A barrel-toast ledger records each barrel's toast level, char depth, and the cellar-master's tasting seal, so a fake cooper cannot invent a vintage. The thread of provenance runs from stave to bottle, the ledge of the cellar holds only sealed casks, and a pearl of doubt sinks any unsealed claim. Forging the seal needs 300 signed tastings a year; one vintner signs once, and a copied ledger fails the tasting.
